features.name: Destination name (city, country)
features.style: Primary travel style (one of: Adventure, Relaxation, Culture, Budget, Luxury, Family)
features.cost_per_day: Estimated daily cost (USD, accommodation + food + activities)
features.density_score: Continuous 0-100 score of tourist density (higher = more crowded)
features.has_beach: Binary: does the destination have beaches? (1=yes)
features.visa_difficulty: Ease of obtaining a tourist visa ('easy', 'medium', 'hard')

generation_notes: Temperature sampled via truncated normal (or uniform fallback). Scores correlate with style probabilities. Extra cities have manually curated styles for realism.
